title: Overtime again?
setting: A weeknight at home. Aoi gets home late from work, worn out; Hikaru has heard some news.

lines.jp: おかえりなさい。{遅|おそ}かったね。また{残業|ざんぎょう}？
lines.en: Welcome home. You're late. Overtime again?

lines.jp: うん。{会議|かいぎ}は{長|なが}いし、メールは{多|おお}いし、もう{疲|つか}れた。
lines.en: Yeah. The meetings go on forever, there are so many emails… I'm worn out.
lines.hint: 〜し、〜し lists reasons one after another: "the meetings are long, and the emails are many…"

lines.jp: お{疲|つか}れ{様|さま}。そういえば、{田中|たなか}さんの{会社|かいしゃ}、{来年|らいねん}{大阪|おおさか}に{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}すそうだよ。
lines.en: You've worked hard. Oh, by the way — I heard Tanaka-san's company is moving to Osaka next year.
lines.hint: Plain form + そうだ passes on news: "I heard that…". Don't confuse it with 〜そう "looks…" (忙しそう).
lines.cue: by the way · Tanaka's company · moving

lines.jp: え、ほんと？ {田中|たなか}さんも{行|い}くの？
lines.en: What, really? Is Tanaka-san going too?

lines.jp: まだわからないって。それより、{明日|あした}も{早|はや}いんでしょう？ お{弁当|べんとう}、{作|つく}っておくね。
lines.en: Tanaka-san doesn't know yet, apparently. Anyway, you're early again tomorrow, aren't you? I'll make your lunch ahead of time.
lines.hint: 〜ておく = do something now, ready for later.
lines.cue: doesn't know yet · early tomorrow · bento

lines.jp: ありがとう。{早|はや}く{終|お}われば、{明日|あした}は{一緒|いっしょ}に{晩|ばん}ご{飯|はん}{食|た}べよう。
lines.en: Thanks. If I finish early, let's have dinner together tomorrow.
lines.hint: 〜ば: 終わる → 終われば "if (I) finish".
